script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: Saying nobody else could back up the promise adds a reason the text does not give. It says God had no one greater to swear by.
The dinner-table joke does not make sense as written: the table is said to need a bigger table.
The text says God made the unchanging nature of His purpose clear, not that He made His purpose itself clear.
The claim that the encouragement comes from God's word and not from us adds a contrast the passage does not make.
Identifying Moses as Israel's leader is a Bible fact outside the passage and needs a reference.
Identifying David as Israel's king is a Bible fact outside the passage and needs a reference.
